extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders and organisations who may wish to make submissions or participate in Productivity Commission inquiries
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for members of the public and stakeholders on contributing to Productivity Commission inquiries via written submissions and public hearings. Includes ways to stay informed about calls for submissions and the Commission's expectation about the kinds of content to provide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open submissions and public hearings encourage participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Open submissions and public hearings encourage you to have your say in Australia's public policy formation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly invites the public to participate in inquiries and research. It directs contributors to share issues they want raised and to provide suggestions for ways forward. (Original text: 'Open submissions and public hearings encourage you to have your say in Australia's public policy formation. Share issues you want raised, and provide suggestions for ways forward.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Share issues and propose ways forward
rubrics_metrics.description: When making a submission, share the issues you want raised and provide suggestions for ways forward.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as the substantive expectation for submissions on the homepage; detailed filing/format/process requirements are referenced via the 'How to make a submission' page (not included here).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use public hearings as a participation channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Public hearings are offered as a mechanism for public engagement alongside written submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage references 'Public hearings' (link) as part of the engagement process. Specific guidance on how to register, attend, or present at hearings is available on the linked page but is not present on the homepage itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay informed via Commission updates and subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the Commission for updates about current inquiries, events and calls for submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage recommends subscribing for email alerts and following the Commission’s social media channels so contributors are aware of calls for submissions and reporting releases. (Original text: 'We post about current inquiries, events and calls for submissions, as well as our findings and links to reporting as soon as it's released. Subscribe for email alerts')
